decision: No source-level execution-contract blocker found. This review does not authorize execution or establish summary quality.
scope: Read-only source, frozen-input and original-nine synthetic-control review; no actual model/native/tokenizer/network call.

exact_change.direct_summary: Remove example JSON values; request only JSON matching the existing supplied schema.
exact_change.excerpt_notes: Remove example values; request the unchanged notes and chapter_title string fields.
exact_change.final_summary: Remove example JSON values; request only JSON matching the existing supplied schema.

source_contract_findings: Thirteen reused execution/source files are byte-identical to the rejected summary stage. The context file changes only its private log directory.
Actual application request captures retain complete 957/1618-byte excerpts, existing response schema/model/options, 240-second timeout and exact unload request; only the system ending changes.

Every actual phase requires root-authored exact-plan/review bindings and an exclusive slot; no phase is automatically launched. Generation additionally requires the reviewed new native setup and its exact report/resources/sample hashes.

Greek requires a separate hash-bound independent review of the complete English paragraph, all key points and chapter with zero major errors and all original criteria satisfied. A failed structural/resource/cleanup phase also blocks continuation.

Generation observes the real application transport, checkpoints the attempt before sending, retains the complete returned parsed native envelope and exact final content before application JSON validation, then preserves the separately delivered application result. Invalid inner JSON is not repaired.

Exactly one full-source generation is allowed per case; exact native renders/token vectors are rechecked before it, and normal stop, empty reasoning, fewer than 2048 output tokens and matching prompt counts are required.
Native setup verifies the retained exact cache/template/parameter map/ordered stops/no persona and actual owned runner. Full prompt plus 2048 output tokens and one terminal reserve must fit 4096.

Unchanged external observer includes monitor/worker/native descendants, retains PID identity and original group/session discovery after leader exit, fails on incomplete measurement, and enforces sampled 6144 MiB RSS, four CPUs, initialization180s/case600s and cumulative900s model-phase time.

Existing application unload acknowledgment, empty resident list and actual owned daemon/group exit are required. A later phase cannot erase the prior measured elapsed time. Source/disk reserve checks remain in the controller.

verification.expected_fake_unload_warning: One synthetic failed-unload test intentionally prints the existing cleanup warning; no actual model is involved.

limits_of_clearance: This is not evidence that removing examples repairs the copied summary filler or the separate quotation-check omission. Both original findings remain material and must be assessed in the new English output.
The changed excerpt-note and final-note-summary prompts are not exercised by the proposed two direct-source cases; no long-summary quality claim follows.
JSON/schema/source hashes and successful synthetic controls cannot establish factual completeness, ownership, permission scope, chronology or useful summary quality.
Actual new native renders/counts, startup/resource series, generation raw responses and independent meaning judgments remain separate stages. This reviewer inspected none of those new outputs.
The RSS limit is sampled process-group accounting, not a kernel cap or complete app/OS memory guarantee.
subsequent_root_action: Root independently issued a prepare-only receipt during this review. Its added authorization file is recorded by name only; it is not approval authored by this reviewer and does not change the frozen source comparison.
